correctness.rationale: An independent derivation uses the causal response K(u)=(1−e^{−u}) for u≥0 and 0 otherwise: the unshaded solution is reduced by ρ[K(t−s)−K(t−s−d)]. Continuity at the switches eliminates moving-boundary contributions. With k=m−1, q=e^{−s}, r=C/q, integrating 2x_s∂_s x_s gives Q'=ρ(1−b)[kq+2r+(bkq−ρ(1−b))r²], exactly ρ(1−b)P(q)/q². At q=C, the bracket in P(C)/C² is ≥(1+b)(1−C)>0; P(1)=(1+bC²)(m−mcrit). For m≥1 P>0 on [C,1]. For m<1, P(0)<0, P(C)>0, P tends to −∞, and strict concavity on q>0 gives one root below C and one above. Only the latter can be interior, precisely for m<mcrit; reversing q with s proves the strict decrease-then-increase pattern. Equality at mcrit leaves Q'(s)>0 for every positive feasible s. At q=√C, the given factorization has the strictly positive term (1−√C)(1+b√C), so the optimum precedes the midpoint of [0,H−d]. The larger root has P_q<0, P_m>0, P_ρ<0, giving the stated opposite signs for the optimizer's two dependencies. For fixed m<1, d and ρ, writing ε=√C and q=εz gives k z³+(2+bkε²)z−ρ(1−b)ε=0; its positive root at ε=0 has derivative −4 in z and continues to a physical root q∈(C,1). Taking −log proves the offset and the claimed error. Separate bisection and integration of the squared trajectory reproduce s*=1.18468780635247 and costs 1.29629488655589 and 1.59833476064739. The frozen verify.py was inspected but not executed; the finite diagnostics are not the proof, and its self-comparison of cubic(1,...) is not an endpoint test.

value.rationale: A fixed-duration, fixed-depth window has identical removed forcing at each placement, so the objective isolates thermal memory in a natural baseline model. The exact threshold predicts the qualitative policy switch with antecedent heat; the two interior parameter effects and the shade-independent leading long-day advance are useful checks on numerical or richer models. The criterion is cumulative squared normalized heat under constant forcing, not yield, crop adaptation, variable irradiance or unrestricted optimal control.
